build_tokenizer_from_path: build a Tokenizer instance from a local BPE vocabulary file path using get_tokenizer
build_tokenizer_from_url: build a Tokenizer instance by downloading a BPE vocabulary file from a URL using get_tokenizer
tokenize_single_text: tokenize a single text string into a padded tensor with start and end tokens using Tokenizer.tokenize
tokenize_batch_texts: tokenize a list of text strings into a batch tensor with configurable context length using Tokenizer.tokenize
review_tokenizer_truncation: review the Tokenizer.tokenize method to understand how it truncates tokens exceeding the context length
